intro.title: Say it the exact way
intro.body:
Some English phrases come in ONE fixed shape: **on holiday** (never *on a holiday*), **in the end**, **by accident**, **on purpose**, **no idea**.
Change one small word and it stops being English. These are not grammar decisions — they are fixed expressions, learned whole.

intro.title: The shapes in this unit
frames: on holiday · on purpose · on a day trip
in secret · in the end · in advance
by accident · a book by + author
to be honest · as far as I know · on the other hand
no idea · out of the blue · it is up to you
intro.note: *In the end* = finally, after everything. *At the end* needs a thing: at the end of the film.

title: Fixed phrases & idioms (B2)
note: V_PHR-B2C1-01 · fixed phrases English says one exact way · on holiday, in secret, no idea, by + author · seeded from Martina's error register 2026-08-16

items.en: We met them while we were on holiday in Italy.
items.cz: Potkali jsme je, když jsme byli na dovolené v Itálii.
items.gap: We met them while we were ____ in Italy.
accepts: We met them while we were on holiday in Italy.

items.en: I planned the whole trip in secret.
accepts: I planned the whole trip in secret.

items.en: He had no idea where we were going.
items.gap: He had ____ where we were going.
accepts: He had no idea where we were going.

items.en: Driving in Naples takes nerves of steel.
items.cz: Řízení v Neapoli chce pevné nervy.
items.gap: Driving in Naples takes nerves of ____.
accepts: Driving in Naples takes nerves of steel.

items.en: Let us try somewhere else next year.
items.cz: Příští rok to zkusíme někde jinde.
items.gap: Let us try ____ else next year.
accepts: Let us try somewhere else next year.

items.en: The Housemaid is a thriller by Freida McFadden.
items.cz: Housemaid je thriller od Freidy McFadden.
items.gap: The Housemaid is a thriller ____ Freida McFadden.
accepts: The Housemaid is a thriller by Freida McFadden.

items.en: We went on a day trip to Pompeii.
items.cz: Jeli jsme na jednodenní výlet do Pompejí.
items.gap: We went ____ a day trip to Pompeii.
accepts: We went on a day trip to Pompeii.

items.en: A quiet weekend helps me recharge my batteries.
items.cz: Klidný víkend mi pomůže načerpat síly.
items.gap: A quiet weekend helps me recharge my ____.
accepts: A quiet weekend helps me recharge my batteries.

items.en: Overall, the reviews are very positive.
accepts: Overall, the reviews are very positive.

items.en: On the other hand, the flat is close to the centre.
items.cz: Na druhou stranu je ten byt blízko centra.
items.gap: On the ____ hand, the flat is close to the centre.
accepts: On the other hand, the flat is close to the centre.

items.en: In the end we chose the cheaper hotel.
accepts: In the end we chose the cheaper hotel.

items.en: To be honest, I did not enjoy the film.
items.cz: Upřímně řečeno, ten film mě nebavil.
items.gap: To be ____, I did not enjoy the film.
accepts: To be honest, I did not enjoy the film.

items.en: As far as I know, the restaurant is still open.
items.cz: Pokud vím, ta restaurace je pořád otevřená.
items.gap: As ____ as I know, the restaurant is still open.
accepts: As far as I know, the restaurant is still open.

items.en: You have to book the tickets in advance.
items.gap: You have to book the tickets ____.
accepts: You have to book the tickets in advance.

items.en: I am sure he did not do it on purpose.
items.gap: I am sure he did not do it ____.
accepts: I am sure he did not do it on purpose.

items.en: I sent the photo by accident.
accepts: I sent the photo by accident.

items.en: The invitation came out of the blue.
items.gap: The invitation came out of the ____.
accepts: The invitation came out of the blue.

items.en: We can stay or go — it is up to you.
items.cz: Můžeme zůstat, nebo jít — je to na tobě.
items.gap: We can stay or go — it is ____ to you.
accepts: We can stay or go — it is up to you.
